messages:
Alice H: Posting updated Request Explorer mocks — focused on correlation-ID affordances & export flow. Quick feedback before dev handoff? Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz :eyes:
Carla (Design): Nice direction. I like the inline corr-id chip — reduces modal opens. Two nits: chip label contrast and tooltip delay feels long right now.
Ben K: Agree on chip. Can we make copy a single click with a toast? Mock currently shows a 2-step modal which will be annoying.
Maria (Eng): Single-click copy + toast is doable. Implementation notes: can't rely on persistent clipboard permission; also want an accessible label: `Copy correlation id to clipboard`. Ensure visible focus ring.
Carla (Design): Yep — will update. Also considering a keyboard shortcut when a trace row is focused (maybe `c`) — need to validate conflicts.
Samir - PM: @Maria for export semantics: do we plan full trace JSON, summarized CSV, or both for MVP? How does this work for Dedicated/Private customers?
Maria (Eng): For MVP ship two options: "Export trace (full JSON)" and "Export summary (CSV)". Big traces can be tens of MBs so we should stream. We also need a backend feature-flag to disable full export for Private customers if required.
Ben K: Accessibility nit: export menu uses `aria-haspopup=\"menu\"` but doesn't toggle `aria-expanded`. Tab order also jumps — actions should be after trace title so keyboard users don't miss them.
Alice H: Thanks. Carla — can you push a variant with high-contrast chip, an inline copy icon, and visually-hidden text for screen readers? Also include a no-JS fallback affordance (copy link button that opens share modal).
Carla (Design): On it. Also adding a small permalink icon next to corr-id so users can open/share in a new tab. Thoughts: permalink copy vs direct copy flow?
Maria (Eng): Permalinks should be GET with `corr_id` param. For private traces we must generate ephemeral signed tokens for links — avoid exposing raw IDs. For share we can provide a short-lived token endpoint.
Samir - PM: Priorities: 1) copy + toast, 2) export menu, 3) permalink. Can we aim to ship copy+toast+export in next sprint? Ephemeral links for Private follow-up.
Carla (Design): :thumbsup: I'll produce updated assets and a small spec (focus states, microcopy, keyboard shortcuts).
deploy-bot: Design snapshot uploaded: https://s3.company/internal/request-explorer-mock-v2.png
Alice H: Great. @Ben can you schedule a 30m dev handoff Tues? Also we need an a11y acceptance checklist attached to the ticket.
Ben K: Booked Tues 10am. I'll add a11y checklist: focus order, `aria-expanded` updates, visible focus ring, screenreader text on copy, keyboard shortcut conflict matrix.
Samir - PM: I'll add acceptance criteria to the product ticket and link the updated mocks. Thanks everyone.
